IDEAS LOGGED (not yet in /ideas/ folder — add when ready):

1. **Cronwell** — Tauri macOS app, plug-and-play task scheduler with catch-up logic (runs missed jobs when Mac wakes). Nothing good exists on Mac; existing options are $36+ or require launchd knowledge. Clear market gap.

2. **Bluetooth LLM speaker** — Always-on speaker you can talk to, routes to own servers (Whisnap VPS transcription + LLM). Like Alexa but self-hosted, Docker-based, conversation history to own server.

3. **Whisnap CLI** — brew-installable, Linux-compatible, same paid features as app. Enables VPS usage, opens developer/power-user market.

4. **HTML Slides Hosting** — Upload HTML presentation, get shareable URL. People generate HTML slides (better than PPT) but struggle to share them. Simple, monetizable.

5. **Whisnap Output Refinement** — Whisnap not only transcribes but reformulates what you said into more precise language. You speak rough → it outputs what you actually meant, more articulately. Over time teaches you to speak more precisely.

6. **Stremio subtitle sync** — Already built (see separate memory).

All these are post-shipping-current-projects territory. Don't start until Vinted is live.
